what: a modelled thread on a hole that isn't the thread's size: refused with the size to use, never a silent change of the hole
method: Decision (#1018, #2853): a modelled thread never changes the size of the hole it is on; one that isn't the thread's size is refused, naming the size to use. A fill-to-tap-drill or turn-down option would be opt-in, off by default (see #3060), and get its own case. The refusal's numbers, from ISO 68-1 (H = P sqrt3/2, basic depth 5H/8): M8 (P 1.25): tap drill = 8 - 1.25 = 6.75 mm; basic minor diameter D1 = 8 - 2 x 5H/8 = 8 - 1.353 = 6.647 mm; a 6.3 mm hole is below the minor diameter, so the thread's teeth would fill part of the hole. Expected message: "this 6.3 mm hole is too narrow for a modelled M8 thread (its teeth would fill the hole); drill 6.75 mm for M8".
refusal: this 6.3 mm hole is too narrow for a modelled M8 thread (its teeth would fill the hole); drill 6.75 mm for M8
